title: Enforce grants mechanically instead of by prompt alone
narrative: Soft guidance may ask models to be careful; hard grants still refuse unauthorized writes. Accepts inspiration requirement 9[^insp-r09]. Complements `fangore_insp_risk_autonomy`.
implementation: `AccessControl` deny-by-default on the harness tool path; prompts never grant permission.
validation: Kind `tool_gating`. Soft expects deny without grant and allow with grant.
